capabilities: read the open note without its frontmatter
compose a website brief from the note text, shortened to about 5,000 characters
open the WeInc builder in the browser with the brief filled in
register a ribbon icon and a command with an optional hotkey
disambiguation: It does not publish the note itself; it only opens the WeInc builder with a pre-filled brief that you review and send manually.
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README stresses privacy: no network requests, API keys, tracking, or settings; note text leaves Obsidian only as part of the opened link.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand a note's content to an external website builder for turning it into a site.

relations.evidence: Opens the WeInc builder in your browser with that brief filled in.

summary: One-command handoff that opens the WeInc website builder in a browser with the current note's text pre-filled as a brief.
